craft_notes: Sthāyin: derived-all (his from yours). Rows: row 2 (yours→not). Close: not (sadasat as landing: real-and-NOT). Rejected: 'everything is you' — kept of-your-nature (tvatmaka as natured-by, precise); 'illusion' for unreal — kept not (the verse keeps both terms).

lines: His waking from yours, his sleep from yours;
hence everything of your nature: the world, real-and-not.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabodhāt prabodho'sya tvannidrāto layo'sya yat | atastvadātmakaṃ sarvaṃ viśva sadasadātmakam

reads_against.argmap: Whose is all this? → Waking and sleep derived: his waking yours, his rest yours — hence all is of your nature, real-and-unreal.
c1_essence: Derived waking and sleep: his waking yours, his rest yours — all of your nature, real-unreal.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling into established holding (stillness that stays)
